limitations: Finite non-walled, no-room metadata proof:12 targets and8 controls, each1659 cells, five foreground/background pairs, lit0/1 and icedpools flag absent/present, seed24301. Fresh loader, smoothed=false, joined=false.

C executes exact finish_map with upstream terrain enum/predicate constants and zero-initialized metadata/no rooms. It receives ONLY the terrain generated by the JS public initializer, not observed JS lighting or ice tags. This isolates the finishing transformation; it is not an independent C terrain-generation, RNG, complete Lua parsing or full API oracle.

C wallify adapter asserts if called, so the walled branch is excluded. Room lighting, joining, smoothing, reused-state metadata, other terrain pairs, all seeds, level finalization and runtime are not proved. Column0 is outside the C finish_map loops and outside the comparison.

Real JS production loader calls des.level_flags("icedpools") when requested and des.level_init({style:"mines",fg,bg,lit,smoothed:false,joined:false,walled:false}). No internal helper injection or gameplay modifications.

The two scanner keys refer to one delegation cause. Finite metadata agreement does not suppress cave topology, cap exit, allocator, join-map, or other helper branches. The cave cap-exit discrepancy and three parked gaps remain unresolved.

Initial scratch fixture incorrectly passed icedpools as a level_init table field. Both production wrappers ignore that field; comparing it to C true was invalid setup, not a divergence/negative. Corrected runs use the supported level_flags API and are the only reported receipts.
